legacy_cells.B: Multimodal Bayesian Network for Robust Assessment of Casualties in Autonomous Triage
legacy_cells.C: Szymon Rusiecki, Cecilia G. Morales, Kimberly Elenberg, Leonard Weiss, Artur W. Dubrawski
legacy_cells.I: 009_2025_Multimodal Bayesian Network for Robust Assessment of Casualties in Autonomous Triage.pdf
legacy_cells.O: Mass-casualty trauma signs and conditions, including severe hemorrhage, respiratory distress, head/torso/extremity trauma, and alertness
legacy_cells.S: Does Bayesian fusion of perception-module outputs improve the accuracy and coverage of casualty physiological-sign and injury assessment versus the perception-only baseline?
legacy_cells.T: 20 casualty cases portrayed by human volunteers and medical mannequins in two MCI scenarios
legacy_cells.V: Support emergency triage by assessing and reporting casualty physiological signs and injury severity
legacy_cells.AI: Categorical labels/predictions from independent perception modules for physiological signs and injuries
legacy_cells.AM: Expert-structured Bayesian network fuses categorical perception outputs by probabilistic inference over clinical variables
legacy_cells.AN: Marginalizes over missing variables and infers from remaining functional sensor inputs
legacy_cells.AT: Categorical findings are entered as hard evidence, updating probabilities of unobserved variables as new observations arrive
legacy_cells.BT: Probabilistic estimates of unobserved physiological variables and patient condition, used for casualty triage assessment
legacy_cells.DN: DARPA Triage Challenge (DTC) Round 1; Open Battlefield and Convoy Ambush scenarios
legacy_cells.EC: DTC score: 25/132 to 61/132 in Open Battlefield and 16/108 to 45/108 in Convoy Ambush; overall correct assignments 25 to 96 and overall performance 14% to 53%
legacy_cells.EG: Inference time below 1 ms; model under 100 MB; reported operation on Raspberry Pi 3
legacy_cells.EI: Perception-only Robot Score versus integrated Robot + BN: 25/132 vs 61/132 (Open Battlefield), 16/108 vs 45/108 (Convoy Ambush); overall correct assignments 25 vs 96
legacy_cells.EL: Airplane Crash mission excluded after a hardware-level failure before deployment prevented consistent data acquisition; authors also report transient sensor failures and occlusions
legacy_cells.FL: Independent perception nodes produce categorical clinical-sign/injury outputs → expert-defined Bayesian network treats findings as evidence and estimates posterior probabilities of unobserved patient conditions → triage assessment outputs; no temporal transition model or planner is reported.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces an expert-elicited Bayesian network for mass-casualty triage that fuses multimodal perception outputs, handles uncertain/incomplete evidence, and is evaluated in DTC field scenarios.
legacy_cells.FN: In Open Battlefield the integrated system scored 61/132 versus 25/132 for Robot-only; in Convoy Ambush, 45/108 versus 16/108. Across cases, correct assignments rose from 25 to 96, reliability from 0.31 to 0.95, and overall performance from 14% to 53%.
legacy_cells.FO: Airplane Crash results were excluded because a hardware-level failure prevented consistent data acquisition. The authors note the need for more comprehensive evaluation, refinement of expert-defined CPTs, lack of standardized MCI datasets, and future confidence-aware integration.
legacy_cells.FP: Refine CPTs using collected field data; integrate sensor-confidence metrics; compare hybrid architectures; add health-trajectory forecasting and care-scheduling optimization; develop human-in-the-loop safeguards and responder collaboration.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify isolated perception models, missing clinical-context integration, and brittleness to noisy or incomplete observations as limitations of autonomous MCI triage systems.
legacy_cells.FR: The demonstrated system estimates current casualty condition from observations; it does not demonstrate temporal state forecasting, action-conditioned transitions, counterfactual treatment comparison, planning, or clinical-patient benefit. Authors list trajectory forecasting and care scheduling as future work.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M7 Outcome & causal layer; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Reuse the evaluated supporting estimator or audit behind a clear component boundary; validate its uncertainty and task limits again when connected to temporal dynamics.
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–10: title page and abstract; Introduction and Related Work; Methods §§3.1–3.3; Tables 1–3; Results §4; Discussion §5; Conclusion and future-work §§6.1–6.4; references inspected for relevant context. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The complete ten-page extracted text was read. Table 2/3 layout is partly disrupted in text extraction; aggregate comparisons are supported by the Results prose and visible aggregate entries. The field competition used volunteers and mannequins rather than clinical patients; conclusions are limited to simulated MCI feasibility and assessment performance. No workbook edits or external access were performed. Evidence QA: 42/51 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (82.4%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 44 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 8 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Read all 10 pages including 20 references. Rendered all 10 and inspected pages 4,6,7,8, covering Figure 1 and Tables 1–3 and explicit future-forecasting/safeguard limits.
Mixed staged human-volunteer/mannequin cases are not 20 injured patients. Three-expert elicitation is not an independent reader-evaluation result. Only R1 staged technical feasibility assigned.
Full CPTs, input models and confidence, stale-evidence handling and actual released code/data are not supplied. A named software dependency is not a release of this system.
Table 2 point-score percentages differ from abstract scenario percentages. Table 3 completion, correctness/possible and accuracy/attempted have distinct denominators and are retained separately.

Raw tables/counts are preserved on PaperVersion; no per-sensor artifacts, participant split, independently measured effect or clinical outcome is invented. No uncertainty-calibration result is reported.
One model full-source extraction with skeptical reread; no independent human review, code replication or external primary-reference retrieval.
notes: Legacy component label, no-world-model status and R1 retained. Current-state Bayesian assimilation is meaningful without being future-state dynamics. Expert causal arrows are not clinical causal identification. The failed third mission remains in limitations instead of being hidden by successful-scenario scores.
